problem_statement: The paper frames the task as predicting financial trajectories or security prices from historical time series. It specifically aims to predict the behaviour of financial instruments and, in its system design, to predict the maximum price reached by a security at a later time.
problem_statement_quotes: This paper introduces a new hybrid deep quantum neural network for financial predictions, the QuantumLeap system.
Thus; our approach aims to predict this behaviour using a quantum computing approach (He et al 2020).
This paper presents a new hybrid deep quantum neural network for the prediction of financial trajectories.
classical_baseline: The paper compares its approach against a classical neural network implementation of the same model and against ARIMA, which it describes as commonly used for time series and financial prediction. It also refers more generally to classical machine learning and empirical/statistical methods as the non-quantum baseline.
classical_baseline_quotes: To further validate the performance of our approach; we compared our   quantum neural network with two   classical models: classical implementation of our quantum network and the autoregressive inte- grated moving average (ARIMA) method, which is commonly employed for time series and financial   predictions (Ozturk & Wolfe, 2000; Zielinski, 1990).

It also says that most quantum methods it cites have high computational cost, and that classical methods have had limited success.
